text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen complying with relevant regulations such as the "Notice of Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work Related to the Admission of International Students by Higher Education Institutions in China". 2. Aged from 18-25 (those who are between 16 and 18 should submit Guardian’s Guarantee Statement). 3. Senior high school diploma (or above). 4. In good health. 5. For Chinese-taught undergraduate programs: a minimum requirement of HSK 4 certificate with a passing score of 180.
